notes: Sourced from ZeeVee's official product datasheet for this exact SKU (Z4KENCC3XS), pulled from zeevee.com/zyper4k-xs-z4kencc3xs-data-sheet/, including the labeled rear-panel diagram and spec table. This is a compact desktop "puck" enclosure (7.8 x 4.6 x 1.9 in / 199 x 116 x 47 mm, 850g) — rackUnits omitted since it isn't natively rack-mountable; ZeeVee sells an optional Z4KRACKXS kit that holds 8 units in 6RU (~0.75RU/unit) if rack mounting is needed. It is the encoder half of the ZyPer4K-XS line and requires a matching ZyPer4K-XS/XR decoder to function; a sibling fiber-network variant (Z4KENCF3XS, SFP+ instead of RJ45 10G) exists but was not used for this record. Video: HDMI 2.0 with HDCP 2.2 pass-through, up to 4K/4096x2160, embedded/analog audio in. USB port is technically Mini-USB 2.0 Type B (approximated to usb-micro, see port note). Power connector is a locking DC connector (approximated to dc-barrel, see port note).

ports.name: USB
ports.note: Datasheet specifies a single Mini USB 2.0 Type B port (for USB pass-through between paired ZyPer4K-XS/XR encoder/decoder units); Mini-B isn't in the connector enum, approximated as usb-micro. Included cable is USB Type-A on the host end.

ports.name: Utility (10/100/1Gb)
ports.note: 1Gb management/utility port, separate from the media-transport network port.

ports.name: 10Gb Ethernet (Media Transport, PoE)
ports.note: 10Gbit copper (Cat6a, 100m) port carrying video/audio/control; PoE-enabled per rear-panel silkscreen.

ports.name: Power (12V DC)
ports.note: Rear panel shows a locking 12V DC, 1.2A power connector (not a plain barrel jack); dc-barrel is the closest enum match. External power supply included in box.
